name: Paludal-Palimpsest
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by magnetic pole anomalies and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in uranium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
